title: 第21章 老道第22章 还有妖
content_zh:
院中上空。
见到敖正现身。
虎君和那白骨道君眉头，同时一皱！
敖正身上那股蛟龙气息，十分明显。
虎君皱眉：
“是海上龙族？”
白骨道君眼中闪过一丝忌惮：
“虎君，龙族势大。”
“我等还是尽量不要与之为敌！”
虎君点了点头。
随后。
它看向下方敖正，客气道：
“我乃听云峰山君。”
“不知阁下是东海龙族哪一支？”
“还请阁下不要插手我与这猴妖之间的事。”
听到虎君的话。
敖正眉头一挑，傲然道：
“本太子乃是东海龙宫十三太子，敖正！”
“你区区一虎妖，也敢自称“山君”
？”

“可有天庭的“封正”
？”
虎君闻言，眉头轻皱。
他这个“山君”
，本就是自封的。
一般外人也不会计较这个。
但敖正却不同。
他虽血脉不纯，但毕竟是东海老龙王的私生子。
哪里会瞧得上这一只虎妖。
若不是孙悟空二人救了过敖正一命。
且二人与敖正性格相投。
那孙悟空在敖正眼里，也就只会是一只猴妖而已。
这也正常，作为群妖之首。
龙族本就看不上其他妖精。
见敖正如此轻视自己，虎君心中有些恼火。
但一想到敖正是东海龙族，却又忍了下来。
它依旧客气道：
“原来是十三太子。”
“我与这猴妖之间，有些仇怨。”
“还望十三太子不要插手。”

敖正瞥了它一眼：
“什么猴妖？”
content_en:
The sky above the courtyard.
Saw Ao Zheng appear.
Lord Tiger and the Bone Dao Lord frowned at the same time!
The dragon aura on Ao Zheng's body was very obvious.
Mr. Tiger frowned:
"Is it the Sea Dragon Clan?"
A trace of fear flashed in the eyes of White Bone Dao Lord:
"Tiger Lord, the dragon clan is powerful."
"I'll try my best not to be an enemy of him!"
Tiger Lord nodded.
Subsequently.
It looked down at Ao Zheng and said politely:
"I am listening to Mr. Yunfeng Mountain."
"I wonder which branch of the East China Sea Dragon Clan you belong to?"
"Please don't interfere between me and this monkey demon."
Hear Mr. Tiger’s words.
Ao Zheng raised his eyebrows and said proudly:
"This prince is the thirteenth prince of the East China Sea Dragon Palace, Ao Zheng!"
"You are just a tiger monster, but you dare to call yourself a tiger"
? "
"Can there be "canonization" from heaven?
? "
Lord Tiger frowned slightly when he heard this.
He is a "tiger"
, which is self-proclaimed.
Most outsiders don't care about this.
But Ao Zheng is different.
Although his blood is impure, he is the illegitimate son of the old Dragon King of the East China Sea after all.
How can one look down on this tiger demon?
If Sun Wukong and the two had not saved Ao Zheng's life.
Moreover, the two of them have similar personalities to Ao Zheng.
In Ao Zheng's eyes, Sun Wukong is nothing more than a monkey demon.
This is normal, as the leader of the group of monsters.
The Dragon Clan doesn't look down on other fairies.
Seeing Ao Zheng despise him so much, Mr. Hu felt a little annoyed.
But when he thought that Ao was from the Dragon Clan of the East China Sea, he endured it.
It still said politely:
"It turns out to be the Thirteenth Prince."
"There is some grudge between me and this monkey demon."
"I hope the Thirteenth Prince will not interfere."
Ao Zheng glanced at it:
"What monkey demon?"
